features.precipitation_signal: 0-3 scale for overall rainfall/hydrometeorological hazard strength.
features.short_duration_intensity_signal: 0-3 scale for bursty/intense short-duration rain potential.
features.storm_duration_signal: 0-3 scale for prolonged rain / multi-hour accumulation potential.
features.training_repetition_signal: 0-3 scale for repeated cells, training, or multiple rounds.
features.antecedent_wetness_signal: 0-3 scale for prior wetness / saturated conditions / additional rain on wet ground.
features.convective_signal: 0-3 scale for thunderstorms, convection, instability, or organized cells.
features.explicit_flash_flood_signal: 0-3 scale for direct flash-flood / flooding language.
features.burn_scar_sensitivity_signal: 0-3 scale for any direct burned-area / debris-flow / runoff sensitivity language.
features.localized_extreme_signal: 0-3 scale for wording that suggests localized but severe rainfall pockets.
features.overall_pfdf_weather_risk: 0-5 summary score for PFDF-relevant weather concern from this text alone.
features.one_sentence_summary: One concise sentence summarizing the PFDF-relevant weather signal.
